name: StripForge
description: Stripboard (Veroboard) layout in KiCad: real footprints, live netlist, copper strips in a normal .kicad_pcb.
description_full:
StripForge turns a KiCad project's real footprints and netlist into stripboard copper on B.Cu at a 2.54 mm pitch. It snaps THT parts to the grid, splits strips by net with real copper gaps plus cut markers, proposes wire links as zero-ohm jumpers that also live in the schematic, relies on KiCad DRC to catch shorts and opens, and exports a mirrored copper-side build sheet.

Pre-alpha: this package is a placeholder and does not do anything yet.
